description: Built-in presets (one JSON file per preset, named by its id: crates/streamcore-input/presets, shipped byte-identical as presets/builtin/<id>.json beside this file) and which profile applies to an app. 'presets': every preset id that must load, each with updatedAt 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z and a fallbacks.redo; presets/builtin holds exactly these files, and each, read as a preset file with its id, gives the profile the built-in library has (round-trip it to check a binding). 'lookups': the preset for an app key (matching is case-insensitive over appKey and aliases; a Windows path reduces to its executable name; '*' is never returned here, null = no preset). 'resolve': the profile that applies given the user's stored profiles: the user's own for the app, else the app's preset, else the user's '*', else the '*' preset; expect names the profile by 'stored:<name>' or 'preset:<id>'. 'effective': the snapshot a client gets: every stored profile, then each preset with at least one key (appKey or alias) no stored profile covers.

resolve.name: preset applies when nothing is stored
a user profile for one key leaves the preset on the other keys

effective.name: a stored profile hides the preset only for the keys it covers
effective.note: photoshop.exe is covered; com.adobe.Photoshop still gets the preset, so the preset stays in the snapshot

effective.name: a stored profile for a new app adds to the presets
a profile with the preset's keys and aliases hides it
